[a7 1/2] # reading-by-text.txt

Notes on reading the web by text message

A page is fetched on a computer that has the internet, reduced to its words,

[a7 2/2] compressed, and sent to the phone in numbered messages. The phone puts the messages back in order, whatever order they arrive in.
>> p! a7 2
[a7 1/2] Each message holds at most 160 characters. Six bytes of every message are a header that says which reply it belongs to and where it goes.
[a7 2/2] If a message goes missing, the phone asks for that one again, and only that one.
